verdict.rationale: SavvyCal documents per-link meeting caps on a per-day, week, and month basis, including per-host limits on round-robin links. It also mentions setting "a few rules on each link" and time-budgeting via calendar events, but the evidence never names the specific rules this story asks for. Missing for 10: buffers before/after meetings, minimum scheduling notice, date-range booking windows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
